page_title: PSG 1-0 ANG | PSG v Angers 22/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Nuno Mendes (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal from a mid-range free kick, but the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A clumsy foul by Lanroy Machine (Angers) and Mickael Leleu blows his whistle. PSG win a free kick.
90' PSG are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
87' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Vitinha (PSG).
87' Alexandre Dujeux has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lanroy Machine (Angers) replacing Yassine Belkhdim.
84' Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
83' The resulting corner from Nuno Mendes (PSG) is cleared.
81' Ousmane Dembele goes off the pitch and Kang-In Lee (PSG) comes on.
80' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

79' PSG slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
77' Substitution. Emmanuel Biumla (Angers) on for Lilian Raolisoa.
77' PSG work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
77' Luis Enrique has decided to substitute Desire Doue and he is replaced by Ibrahim Mbaye (PSG).
77' Substitution. Jacques Ekomie will be replaced by Florent Hanin (Angers).
76' Desire Doue (PSG) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The linesman makes the right call and PSG will have a corner.

75' A neat pass is well received by Goncalo Ramos (PSG), who is lurking on the edge of the box and produces a low drive directed towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
73' Wonderful movement by PSG. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
70' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
68' Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for PSG.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Bradley Barcola as he is replaced by Goncalo Ramos (PSG).
66' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Joao Neves will be replaced by Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG).

65' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. PSG are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
62' Substitution. Sidiki Cherif is replaced by Jim Allevinah (Angers).
61' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

61' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. PSG are awarded a corner kick.
60' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.

58' Joao Neves (PSG) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
57' Nuno Mendes (PSG) will take the corner.
57' PSG show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball is out of play. PSG win a corner kick.
54' Nuno Mendes (PSG) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
52' Angers are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
50' 1 - 0 Goal! Fabian Ruiz (PSG) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the right post. It's 1:0.
48' Nuno Mendes (PSG) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. Pierrick Capelle (Angers) for Marius Courcoul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+4' Vitinha (PSG) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
45+3' PSG show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

42' Vitinha (PSG) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.

41' A brilliant individual effort! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tricks his way past challenges into the box and blazes his shot just a few inches over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
40' The ball is cleared after Desire Doue (PSG) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

38' The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers. Joao Neves (PSG) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
37' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
35' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
35' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Now PSG have a corner.
34' A wild pass somehow finds Desire Doue (PSG) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
33' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
32' Desire Doue (PSG) steps up and sends the mid-range free kick miles over the bar. Strong but inaccurate shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
29' PSG are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
27' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) misses the penalty! His poor effort goes well over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.
26' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

26' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marius Courcoul (Angers). Mickael Leleu saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. That's a penalty to PSG! They have a good chance to score now.
24' PSG are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' An injury to the match referee means he is going to have to be replaced by Mickael Leleu.
18' Desire Doue (PSG) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
17' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat. Corner kick. PSG will have an opportunity.
16' A pass from Desire Doue (PSG) is intercepted by Herve Koffi and the move breaks down.
15' PSG seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

13' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and PSG will have a goal kick.
12' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
12' Bradley Barcola (PSG) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee blows his whistle, PSG are awarded a corner kick.
10' Desire Doue (PSG) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
9' The resulting corner from Desire Doue (PSG) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
8' Nuno Mendes (PSG) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
7' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
4' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
3' PSG showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. The ball has crossed the sideline. Angers are taking a throw-in.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Hakim Ben El Hadj Salem will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
